7. Learned Senior Assistant Judge, Biswanath, Sylhet awarded a decree in favour of plaintiff. Judgment and decree is dated 6.3.1994. In awarding decree learned Senior Assistant Judge as trial Judge considered pleadings, evidences, both oral and documentary and legal points involved in the suit and rendered positive decision that interminating plaintiff the mandatory provisions of Section 18(b) of Bank's Staff (Service) Rules, 1965 had not been followed and the said termination order is tainted with malafide on the part of Defendant Bank and said order of termination could not stand on legal scrutiny. 

 8. Defendant Uttara Bank Limited felt aggrieved of the above adjudication and sought setting aside same through a medium of appeal being Title Appeal No. 102 of 1994 in the court of District Judge, Sylhet. Learned Subordinate Judge, First Court, Sylhet heard the appeal and by judgment and decree dated 3.11.1997 dismissed the appeal. In recording dismissal learned Subordinate Judge as appellate Judge took into account pleadings, evidences, both oral and documentary and other materials brought on record and came in full 'agreement with the decisions rendered by trial Judge and found no ground to interfere with those decisions. 

 44. Order of stay recorded at the time of issuance Rule dated 13.7.1998 staying operation of the impugned judgment and decree passed in Title Appeal No. 102 of 1994 stands vacated.
